import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DifferentialOrder
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorSheafZero

/-!
# Regularity and nonnegative differential order

A rational differential belongs to the regular local lattice exactly when
its coordinate in a regular frame lies in the local ring. For a nonzero
differential this is equivalent to nonnegative integer order.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A rational differential is regular exactly when its coordinate in a
regular local frame has valuation at most one. -/
theorem mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (e : X.left.presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x ↔
      orderAt X.hom hx (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e ω) ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hω
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := e.surjective ⟨ω, hω⟩
    have hval : (e a : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = ω :=
      congrArg Subtype.val ha
    rw [← hval, curveDifferentialCoordinate_frame]
    exact orderAt_algebraMap_stalk_le_one hx a
  · intro hω
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_stalk_of_order_le_one hx hω
    have hval : (e a : CurveRationalDifferentials X) = ω :=
      (curveDifferentialCoordinate X x e).injective
        ((curveDifferentialCoordinate_frame X x e a).trans ha)
    rw [← hval]
    exact (e a).property

/-- The classical integer order is nonnegative exactly when the adic
valuation is at most one. -/
theorem orderZAt_toAdd_nonneg_iff {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    0 ≤ Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) ↔
      orderAt X.hom hx (g : X.left.functionField) ≤ 1 := by
  change (1 : Multiplicative ℤ) ≤ orderZAt X.hom hx g ↔ _
  unfold orderZAt
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, invMonoidHom_apply,
    MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, one_le_inv']
  rw [← WithZero.coe_le_one, WithZero.coe_unitsWithZeroEquiv_eq_units_val]
  rfl

/-- A nonzero rational differential has nonnegative order at a point exactly
when it belongs to the regular differential lattice there. -/
theorem curveDifferentialOrder_nonneg_iff {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ curveDifferentialOrder X hx ω hω ↔
      ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  rw [curveDifferentialOrder, orderZAt_toAdd_nonneg_iff]
  exact (mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice_iff X hx (curveDifferentialFrame X x) ω).symm

end
end Hartshorne
